facebook.caption: Tourists walk straight past this place on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo. Their loss. Rajwadi Zaikah Indian Restaurant is pulling 4.7 stars across 297 reviews and most beach-goers have no idea it exists. Real curry, real spice, real naan. $15-30 a head for a full meal. On an island where seafood dominates every menu, finding Indian food this good hits different. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
